scope: Four nearby UI studies with distinct per-bot Roky avatars and a separate eight-variant avatar study; no application changes.
avatarPrompt:
Create an ORIGINAL ROKI / ROKY AVATAR VARIATION STUDY for the Hermes Studio app. The user selected the Graphite & Amber interface and specifically asks for other Roky avatars, not the same default repeated.
INPUT 1: canonical Roki character reference sheet, IDENTITY/CONSTRUCTION REFERENCE. INPUT 2: selected Graphite & Amber interface, CONTEXT REFERENCE. Preserve Roki's species and construction exactly: compact faceted rock body, recessed dark face, two expressive warm eyes, small orange side insert, short original sneakers with dark straps and orange soles. No animals, plants, typographic mascots, unrelated robots, horns, costumes, hats or props. Variations should be recognizably related Rokys. Character identity is the subject; no interface needs to be drawn on this sheet.
OUTPUT: premium LANDSCAPE 3:2 white character study, 4 columns x 2 rows. EIGHT distinct characters, evenly spaced and clearly labelled with the exact numbers/names below. Each cell has one well-rendered FULL-BODY character about 200px tall plus a matching compact HEAD-ONLY portrait around 64px inside a neutral clear rounded UI tile. Full bodies and portraits must match within each cell. No elaborate background, no room, no podium, no cast garden scenery, no colored background gradient; pure WHITE #FFFFFF and a minimal natural contact shadow under each full-body figure. Make it look like a careful production avatar catalogue, not a marketing poster. Small title "Roky / Graphite & Amber / Character studies".
CHARACTER VARIANTS:
01 BASALT: dark matte graphite, broad stable five-sided rock with LARGE softened facets, calm upright warm-cream eyes spaced slightly wide, original small orange insert. The closest to canonical Roki, but warmer and less armored in the lighting.
02 PEARL: cool PURE WHITE / pale neutral ceramic-stone body with a slightly taller soft faceted crown, graphite inset face, relaxed warm-amber eyes, saturated orange side insert. Do not tint the white body beige or ivory.
03 EMBER: vivid saturated burnt-ORANGE mineral body, rounded compact pentagonal silhouette, charcoal recessed face, two cheerful small curved eye arcs. Not a flame creature. Keep stone facets and original orange side detail visible through a slightly brighter orange edge.
04 COBALT: rich deep BLUE mineral rock, taller asymmetrical faceted crown, charcoal inset face, curious gently raised eye spacing (both open and friendly), a vivid orange side insert. No horns, ears, ice crystals or armor.
05 SLATE: light cool blue-GRAY stone, broader rounded-square facets and softer cheeks, SHALLOW charcoal face recess, relaxed upright cream eyes. Orange insert angled slightly lower. Friendly calm face.
06 COPPER: satin copper-orange METALLIC STONE with broad smooth polygon facets, slightly narrow tapering silhouette, charcoal face, two pleasant open eyes with restrained glow. Tiny bright orange side insert. Refined material, no realistic weathering, rust or beige cast.
07 JADE: rich saturated mineral EMERALD-GREEN stone, compact offset crown and uneven large facets, charcoal face, a friendly one-round-one-upright curious eye expression. Orange side insert. No leaf, vine or plant elements.
08 TITANIUM: pale neutral SILVER-GRAY satin mineral, wide lower body and gently clipped upper corners, graphite face recess with gently happy open eye arcs, orange side insert. Not chrome mirror armor, no harsh specular reflections.
MATCHING FAMILY RULES: use the same Roki shoe construction throughout; shoe hues may be white, graphite and orange to suit the body. Facets and material vary but not into smooth generic blobs. Portraits have no legs, sneakers or miniature full body, just the well-framed head/body shape. No angry inward-slanting eyes, no sinister brows, no overexposed eye glow, no mouth or teeth. Soft even front-top lighting; friendly and tactile at 28–64px. Each character must be genuinely distinct in color AND silhouette/eye treatment while clearly belonging to Roki's family. Exact label spelling and no duplicate characters.
